name: Samurai: Ronin's Path
description:
About This Game

"The path of the samurai does not lead to glory. It leads through blood, silence, and death."



In a world where honor can be a weakness and the blade speaks faster than words, only one thing matters: survive without losing your honor.
Step onto the path of a warrior who neither asks for forgiveness nor shows mercy. There is no room for mistakes here - every fight is a test of skill, and every death is a lesson.

Combat - Fast, Brutal, Unforgiving

At the core of the game lies dynamic melee combat where every strike matters, and even the smallest mistake can cost you your life. Wield your katana, deliver deadly blows, and create devastating combos. A precise counter system will allow you to dominate your enemies in the blink of an eye - if your timing is perfect.

Tactics Over Strength

Your enemies do not fight honorably - they attack in numbers and without mercy. Even the weakest foe can become a deadly threat. Success depends on battlefield control and a calm assessment of the situation.

Progression and Customization

As you progress, you will unlock new abilities, dodges, and upgrades, allowing you to create your own unique fighting style.

Levels Without a Moment of Boredom

Each stage combines exploration and combat. Progress through diverse locations, uncover new areas, and fight your way through intense arena battles. Face a wide variety of enemies and unique bosses - all delivered in the spirit of classic arcade action.

"If you fear death - do not raise your sword."
short_desc: Samurai: Ronin's Path is a dynamic action game set in feudal Japan. Fight in true samurai style, unlock new abilities, avoid death, and cut down your enemies using an extensive arsenal available to Asian warriors.
